title: Total Simulated Survey Error: Designing and Diagnosing Survey Responses from Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance of LLM-simulated survey responses (vote choice predictions) against human benchmark data (ANES) by disaggregating accuracy metrics (F1 score and Total Variation Distance) across different political ideology subgroups (e.g., liberals, moderates, conservatives) to identify systematic persona simulation errors.
